author: sajana magar
review_text: Worst customer service ever! My ID was suspended for using the same KYC for two numbers. After visiting the Pokhara branch to delete the old account, some money remained. Despite writing letters and emails, the funds were never redirected. For five months, I visited the office, but they falsely claimed the money was transferred. Even after providing statements and confirming with headquarters, the issue remains unresolved. The staff are unhelpful and clueless.🙂
